text: Coffee with Nia and Dawit. Nia starts at the council planning office next Monday, first day at 9. Dawit's still at the bakery but wants to go full time. Their daughter Hana is applying for uni this year, mostly Scottish ones. Text Nia Monday evening to see how it went.

Kwame turns 40 on Saturday. His wife Rachel says he's obsessed with sourdough at the moment, so a proper banneton would go down well. Party's at theirs from 7. Rachel also said his brother Emeka is flying in from Lagos for it, first visit in years, and Kwame has no idea. Don't mention it on Friday when I see him.
Agnieszka lives in Leith now, top floor flat near the shore. Her partner Javier works for the port authority. Two kids, both at the primary round the corner.

Long call with Emeka. He handed his notice in on Friday and finishes at the bank in a fortnight. Starts at the fintech place the Monday after. He's a bit nervous about the pay cut but excited overall. Dalia is throwing him leaving drinks next Thursday at 6, the Crown. I should chip in for his card.
Eamon's retiring after 31 years at the depot! Do is the 14th, 2pm in the canteen. Need to get him something, he's into fly fishing.
Hana said Gustavo got the promotion to head chef. Starts the new role after half term. Send him congrats tomorrow morning.
Paolo and Kate's anniversary is this weekend, ten years. They're doing a night away in the Lakes. Kate mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder, filing that away for Christmas.
Ravi works nights at the hospital pharmacy. Lives with his brother Kieran in Salford. Kieran's a plumber, self employed.
Miriam's mum is 80 on Sunday. Big lunch at the golf club, half 12. Miriam's stressed about the seating plan and her sister Shira not pulling her weight. Ring Miriam Monday to see how it went.

Bumped into Liam outside Tesco. Yosef from his work got made redundant yesterday, the whole team's gutted. Liam thinks he'll be next. His wife Gemma is on maternity so money's tight, and he's been checking job sites every night. Want to know how Yosef gets on too.
Farah's first day at the law firm tomorrow at 8.30. She's terrified. Must text her good luck tonight.
Pick up dry cleaning Thursday after 4. Book the car in for its MOT next week.
Akira lives in Kyoto half the year, rest of the time with her daughter Ellie in Bristol. Ellie teaches piano. Akira used to be an architect.

Bilal's birthday Wednesday. He's mad into vinyl, specifically old soul pressings. Caroline (his other half) said he's been hinting about a new turntable needle. Order one by Monday so it arrives in time.

Catch-up with Svetlana and Thomas. Svetlana got the deputy head job, starts January. Thomas is leaving the civil service on Friday to go freelance, his last day's at 3. They're both knackered but happy.
Andile mentioned his dad's retirement party got called off, his dad had a fall last week. He's in hospital till at least Tuesday. Check in with Andile at the weekend.

Gemma's niece turns 18 next Saturday. Gemma wants to get her driving lessons. Henrik is doing the cake. The niece, Anika, is into K-pop and skincare, so a gift set could work as a backup. Party is Saturday at 4 at the cricket club.
Anika works at the uni library, been there forever. Married to Kwame's cousin Dawit. They live in Headingley with a greyhound called Biscuit.

Rachel's interview at the hospice is Tuesday at 10am. She's really nervous, hasn't interviewed in 12 years. Her husband Javier keeps telling her she'll smash it. Don't forget to text her Tuesday morning before it, then ring Wednesday to hear how it went.
Emeka said Agnieszka's leaving do was brilliant on Friday. She's off to Warsaw for the new job, flies out the 3rd. I should message her before she goes.
Nia's birthday's the 22nd. Into bouldering at the moment and terrible plant collections. Kate said a climbing chalk bag wd be perfect.
Kieran said his sister Hana's moving to Glasgow next month for a promotion at the BBC. She's nervous about not knowing anyone. Liam and I are helping her pack on Saturday morning.

Tea with Miriam. Her son Yosef started at the garage last Monday as an apprentice mechanic. Loving it apparently. Her husband works at the same place, so it's a family affair. Must ask Yosef how week two goes.
Gustavo, aka Gus, turns 50 a week Friday. Surprise meal at the tapas place, 8pm, Paolo organising. Gus loves Rioja and Real Madrid. Need to sort a gift before Thursday.
Dalia's retiring from nursing at Christmas after 35 years. Her daughter Farah is planning a do for the 19th. Dalia says she's dreading the quiet.
Ellie lives in Cardiff, works for the Welsh government in comms. Her husband Bilal is a paramedic. Their twins are 7.
Hana's dog Pepper had surgery on her hip this morning. Hana sounded wrecked. Text her tomorrow to see how Pepper's doing.
Quick catch-up with Ravi, nothing much new.

Caroline's in her final week at the estate agents, last day Friday at 5. Starts at Savills on the 2nd. Henrik's taking her away for the weekend in between, a cottage near Whitby. She says she'll miss her team but not the commute. Remind me to get Caroline a good luck card.

Svetlana's brother Andile is getting married next spring, not sure of the date yet. Svetlana's maid of honour and already panicking about the speech. Her mum isn't well either, MS diagnosis last year. Svetlana's a nurse at St James's and lives with her partner Kieran out in Horsforth. I should ask how the speech is going next Wednesday.
Thomas got promoted to senior engineer! Told me at five a side. His wife Gemma's expecting in March. Send Thomas a congrats message tonight.
Akira Nakamura from book club works at the Japanese consulate. Lives in Kensington, has a cat called Mochi. Into ceramics, takes a class on Thursdays.
Birthday list for October: Kwame on the 4th, Anika the 11th, Eamon the 27th. Anika wants nothing but secretly loves fancy candles. Eamon's into whisky. Need to order both by next Tuesday.

Liam Osei got the job at the stadium! Grounds manager, starts Monday the 3rd at 7am. Big deal for him after a rough year. His girlfriend Shira is over the moon. Text him Sunday night good luck and the following Friday to see how week one went.
Javier's leaving the restaurant after eight years. Last shift is Saturday night. He's opening a food truck with his brother Paolo in spring.
Called Mum. Doing her shopping Saturday morning then lunch at hers.
Kate's dad is retiring on Friday, 40 years as a postman. Kate's organising a surprise afternoon tea at 3. She's struggling with it all, work's mental too. Drop her a message tomorrow evening.
Dawit Adeyemi, Nia's husband, now runs the IT department at the college. They live just off Chapel Allerton high street. Nia's mum lives with them.

Farah said Kieran's starting at the fire service next Tuesday, training's 12 weeks. He's been nervous all summer. Their kids are mad excited. I need to call Kieran on Wednesday after his first day. Also Farah's own birthday is the Sunday after, she wants a decent rain jacket.
Gemma's 30th birthday drinks were meant to be Saturday but she's cancelled, she's got Covid. Moving it to the 25th instead. Must send her soup or something.
Emeka loves anything Arsenal and is learning to cook Ethiopian food. Birthday's in a fortnight. Maybe a cookbook.
Henrik Schmidt starts at the new firm on Monday, his first proper job since the redundancy. Eamon says he's barely slept. Don't forget to send Henrik a good luck text Sunday evening.

Rachel and Kwame are moving to Bristol in the new year for Rachel's job. Kwame's going to keep working remotely. Their son Thomas is staying put to finish uni. Rachel's mum lives nearby so it makes sense.

Lunch with Ellie and Miriam. Ellie's off on maternity in two weeks, baby due 18th Nov. Miriam just got a promotion to practice manager, starts the new role next Monday. Miriam's son Bilal turns 21 on Sunday and wants a gaming chair. Need to send Ellie flowers and congratulate Miriam.
Svetlana Kowalski, Andile's wife, teaches at the Polish Saturday school. They live in Ealing. Her parents are in Kraków.
Paolo said his boss is retiring next month and he might get the manager job. Interview's Friday at 11. He's playing it cool but definitely anxious.
Akira's leaving do is tomorrow at half 5. She's off to Osaka for good. Bring the card everyone signed.
Remind me to ask Dalia how her first week at the dental practice went. Started last Monday. She was really worried beforehand.
Kwame's sister Agnieszka turned 30 yesterday. Missed it completely! Send her a belated message and a gift voucher today.

Catch-up call with Hana. She's finally settled in Manchester, works at the Co-op head office in HR. Her girlfriend Nia moved up with her in August. Nia's still looking for work. Hana's birthday is next Friday, she'd like a new yoga mat.
Gym, then batch cook for the week. Tuesday 7pm dentist.
Bilal's retirement has been pushed back to June, his manager asked him to stay. Caroline's relieved, she wasn't ready for him at home all day.
Ravi got into the Royal Ballet School! His dad Yosef was beaming at the school gate. Starts September.
Thomas mentioned his grandad passed away on Monday. Funeral's next Thursday at 11. He seemed okay but quiet. I should check in with him at the weekend.
Ellie Lee, our new neighbour, works as a vet. Grew up in Belfast. Her partner Eamon is a carpenter. They have a spaniel called Scout.
Gemma's son Liam is going to uni in Leeds next week. She's a mess about it. Her husband Henrik's driving him up Saturday morning. Text Gemma on Sunday.

Nice long walk with Farah and Kate. Farah's mum just retired from teaching, they're throwing her a garden party Saturday 2pm. Kate's in a new job at the gallery, loves it. Kate's birthday's the 30th, she mentioned wanting a film camera.
Kieran's brother Gustavo finished his apprenticeship and got kept on as a full electrician. Party's next Saturday. Gustavo's really into gaming, a new controller would be a good shout.
Andile hates surprises and doesn't drink, keep in mind for his 40th in December.

Agnieszka mentioned her husband Javier has his performance review Thursday at 2. He's been stressed for weeks about it. She's got a scan the following Monday too, nothing serious she says. Message Agnieszka on Monday afternoon to check in.
